note: Experimental pilot decision policy, not a validated benchmark or canonical Problem Commons requirement.
principles: Owner/reviewer thresholds gate this pilot workflow only; they do not prove external validity.
No score automatically publishes or authorizes a problem.
Promotion requires an explicit curator action and the canonical Problem Packet transition rules.
External authority, test success, deployment, and outcomes must be recorded in their own authoritative planes.
Low solver conversion is evidence about the packet/decomposition or incentives, not a reason to inflate rubric scores.
